problem: Do internal diagonal records along source-native interaction words separate the full finite shift-defect algebra, including off-diagonal residues invisible to immediate observation?
bold_conjecture: The behavior coalgebra remains blind to off-diagonal shift-defect states because every immediate record is diagonal.
named_rivals: native matrix-unit probes reconstruct every coefficient
fixed bounded word-depth suffices uniformly in cutoff

definitions.coefficient_formula: the b-th diagonal entry of Delta(E_ba X) equals X_ab

acceptance_tests: every E_ba has the stated native word
every matrix coefficient is recovered by one probe record
the total behavior map has rank N squared
immediate Delta alone has rank N
a fixed probe word-depth does not cover unbounded cutoff
claim_boundary: Exact finite behavioral-faithfulness theorem for the interaction repertoire containing left multiplication by native shift-defect words. It does not prove faithfulness for the four-port analytic coalgebra or for a conjugation-only constructor category.
